title: Go Make Money
summary: Give Claude your real money goal, not a task: it reads your raw Threadify rows, finds the biggest funnel leak with receipts, tests your belief about why, has a different model judge the diagnosis, lists the 3 claims a skeptical buyer would doubt, argues three decisions and ships fix #1 after one exact yes, then saves a goal ledger that grades the fix next run.
triggers: why don't my clicks turn into signups

inputs.name: the owner's goal (N paying customers or members by a date), current baseline or UNKNOWN, connected Threadify account (posts, tracked links, signups, offers, conversion setup), the public landing page, optional data/ files such as YouTube analytics

outputs.name: go-make-money/<date>/ folder with goal.json, raw/ reads, funnel.json, beliefs.json, judge.json, short-seller.json, decisions.json, fix.json and a local report.html, plus the goal ledger at ~/.threadify/go-make-money/ledger.json

free_capabilities: deterministic goal and pace math: required_net_new_per_week = ceil((goal - current) / weeks_left), unknown baseline labelled needs real baseline
deterministic funnel from raw per-link and per-post rows: views, clicks, signups, paid, per-step rates and the biggest drop
belief tests: promise vs landing page words, and CTA reach from retention data
outside judge on a different model (codex exec read-only, else a fresh Claude) with a hard time limit
short-seller quote check, decision ranking, public copy guard and casing guard
goal ledger that grades the last fix on the same numbers
paid_capability_stubs: link attribution and post performance history depend on the plan's analytics window
Threadify post generation counts toward the plan's AI generations
Auto Plug replies need a plan that includes Auto Plug
connected offer changes, scheduling and readback

must_show: the exact change: offer fields before and after, the exact post and Auto Plug, or the exact diff
local date and time for a scheduled post

instructions: Without a Threadify connection, stop after the goal and say what to connect.
When a number is not returned, show it as UNKNOWN, never 0; an unknown baseline is labelled needs real baseline.
When conversion tracking is not measurable, signups and paid are UNKNOWN.
When neither codex nor the claude command line is installed, say the outside judge could not run; never invent a verdict.
Never write posts yourself when Threadify generation is unavailable; report the blocker.
When Auto Plug is not on the plan, state the tier and offer the post without a plug.
Never merge a landing-page pull request; open it and print its URL only.

must_prove: raw read windows and destination filter
funnel counts and the leak with receipts
